name: Future Mod
description: Frame window counter for GD: a CBF-aware macro bot that measures every click's frame window, NaN-style replay rings, frame windows on death, NaNDL comparison, plus optional cheat modules (click indicator, window extender, LDM instaswap). Also: skip level endings with a key.

skip-end.name: Exit Level Ending
skip-end.description: Press this while a level is finishing to instantly exit the level, skipping the end animation, the delay, and the completion screen. The level still counts as completed. Only active during the ending, so it's safe to set to your jump key (e.g. Space).

macro-enabled.name: Enable macro features
macro-enabled.description: Master switch for the macro bot, frame window analysis, playback display, death display and the cheat modules. Off = all of it is disabled; 'Exit Level Ending' keeps working.

macro-record.name: Record
macro-record.description: Start / stop recording your inputs (normal mode). Works with Click Between Frames and from start positions (each start position gets its own macro). Recording restarts when you die, so it keeps the attempt you complete.

macro-play.name: Replay
macro-play.description: Replay the recorded macro, with frame window rings if it has been analyzed. A replay is the bot playing: it's marked CHEATING and never saves progress.

macro-analyze.name: Analyze frame windows
macro-analyze.description: Measure every input's frame window. Hands off while it runs; no noclip/speedhack, and turn off CBF's Physics Bypass. Results: rings on replay, the death display, the NaNDL comparison, and export files (pause menu > Files).

analyze-releases.name: Analyze releases too
analyze-releases.description: Also measure the timing window of RELEASES (letting go), not just presses. Wave/ship straight-flying is mostly release timing. Short taps are measured as one gesture either way. Turn off for cube-only levels to halve analysis time.

fw-max-window.name: Max window (frames)
fw-max-window.description: Windows wider than this many 240 Hz frames are reported as 'wide' (not a timing) and stop being probed. 10 matches NaN's lists; lower = faster analysis.

fw-subframe.name: Sub-frame precision (CBF)
fw-subframe.description: On CBF runs, every input's window is measured below one frame (as NaN does): each edge is narrowed this many times. 5 = edges to 1/64 frame (about two decimals, NaN measures to 0.01), 3 = 1/16, 0 = whole frames only. Each step costs two extra runs per input. Has no effect on runs recorded without CBF.

fw-ring-size.name: Ring size
fw-ring-size.description: How big the frame window rings and their numbers are, on replay and on death. 1 = normal, 0.5 = half, 2 = double. Applies live.

fw-ring-pop.name: Ring pop-in animation
fw-ring-pop.description: Rings scale up quickly when they appear. Turn off to have them appear instantly at full size.

fw-rings.name: Frame window rings
fw-rings.description: During macro playback (K), draw a ring on the player at every analyzed click and release, the moment it happens, labelled with its frame window and coloured by it (red = tight, green = loose; pink = sub-frame with CBF). A counter in the top-left shows how many inputs of each window you've passed so far. Same display as NaN GD's frame window videos. Run the analyzer (N) once first so the windows are known.

fw-sound.name: Frame window sound
fw-sound.description: Play a sound on every analyzed input during playback. Its pitch follows the window: a 1-frame input is the lowest note and each extra frame steps it up, so you can hear how tight a section is.

fw-sound-file.name: Sound file
fw-sound-file.description: A GD sound name (e.g. counter003.ogg, playSound_01.ogg), a file you put in this mod's config folder, or a full path to an .ogg/.mp3/.wav. Falls back to playSound_01.ogg if it can't be found.

fw-sound-volume.name: Sound volume
fw-sound-volume.description: Volume of the frame window sound (also scaled by GD's SFX volume).

death-title.name: Frame windows on death (not a cheat)

death-windows.name: Show on death
death-windows.description: When you die while playing normally: 'Died-on click' puts a frame window ring where you made the click you died on (the latest click whose window had opened when you died). 'All' rings every click you passed this attempt. Only rings, no text. Uses your analysis of the level or imported windows. Not a cheat: it only shows information after you die.

nandl-compare.name: Compare with NaNDL after analysis
nandl-compare.description: When an analysis finishes on a level that's listed on nandl.pages.dev, show NaN's frame window counts next to yours. Turn off to skip the popup; the pause menu NaNDL button still works.

nandl-name.name: NaNDL level name
nandl-name.description: The level's name on nandl.pages.dev, if it differs from its name in GD. Leave blank to use the GD name. Used by the NaNDL comparison after an analysis and by the pause menu NaNDL button.

editor-title.name: Macro editor (pause menu > Edit macro)
editor-title.description: A timeline of your macro over the level itself: move clicks by tiny amounts, add or delete clicks, and see straight away whether the changed macro still makes it. Uses the macro replay, so it counts as a cheat while open.

editor-snap-cbf.name: CBF snap step
editor-snap-cbf.description: How finely clicks of a CBF macro move (in frames, 240 a second). Hold Shift while dragging (or nudging with the arrow keys) for 8x finer. Clicks of a normal (non-CBF) macro always move by whole frames: the game can only apply them on a frame.

editor-resim-seconds.name: Re-simulate after an edit (seconds)
editor-resim-seconds.description: After you move, add or delete a click, this much of the level from the change on is played again with the edited macro, so you see the new path and whether it dies. Seeking further plays more as needed.

editor-resim-to-end.name: Re-simulate to the end
editor-resim-to-end.description: Play the edited macro all the way to the end after every edit (slower on long levels, but you always see whether the whole run still works).

editor-savestate-steps.name: Save-state every N steps
editor-savestate-steps.description: How often the editor keeps a save-state of the run (240 steps = 1 second). Lower = faster seeking and re-simulating, more memory.

editor-play-speed.name: Play speed
editor-play-speed.description: Speed of the Play button (Space) in the editor. 1 = normal.

editor-default-hold.name: Added click length (frames)
editor-default-hold.description: How long a click added with Add (A) is held, in frames.

editor-preview-lead.name: Show the level before a click (frames)
editor-preview-lead.description: When you select or move a click, the level is shown this many frames before it, so you see the approach.

editor-show-on-level.name: Draw on the level
editor-show-on-level.description: Draw the path, clicks and frame windows on the level itself (not only on the timeline).

editor-show-path.name: Show the path
editor-show-path.description: The edited macro's path where it has been simulated (cyan; pink for player 2).

editor-show-original.name: Show the original path
editor-show-original.description: The path of the macro as it was when you opened the editor, faint, to compare with the edited one.

editor-show-windows.name: Show frame windows
editor-show-windows.description: Each analyzed click's frame window, behind it on the timeline and along the path (red 1f or less, orange 2, yellow 4, green wider). Faded for a moved click: it was measured at the old time.

editor-show-modes.name: Show gamemode strip
editor-show-modes.description: A coloured strip of the gamemodes (darker = mini) and speed changes along the timeline.

editor-timeline-height.name: Timeline size
editor-timeline-height.description: Height of the timeline at the bottom. 1 = normal.

editor-undo-limit.name: Undo steps
editor-undo-limit.description: How many edits can be undone.

editor-confirm-exit.name: Ask before discarding
editor-confirm-exit.description: Ask whether to save when you leave the editor with unsaved changes.

cheat-title.name: Cheat modules (CHEATING shows only while one is in use)

mod-click-indicator.name: Click indicator
mod-click-indicator.description: CHEAT. A line in the level at the dead centre of every upcoming click's frame window (coloured by the window, red = tight; releases fainter). It scrolls with the level: click when your icon crosses it. Uses the level's analyzed windows (your analysis or an import). While it's showing lines, the attempt is marked CHEATING and doesn't save progress.

mod-window-extender.name: Window extender
mod-window-extender.description: CHEAT. Makes the clicks you're NOT practicing easier, so you can focus on the ones you are. You still play every click yourself: if you're early or late by at most 'Extra frames' outside a click's real frame window, the click is moved into the window and you survive; further off and you die like normal. Late clicks are caught by the game briefly holding at the window's last frame (never longer than the extra frames). Pick the clicks to practice with NO help in the pause menu > Extender. Uses the level's frame windows (analysis or import). While it's helping, the attempt is marked CHEATING and doesn't save progress.

extender-frames.name: Extra frames
extender-frames.description: How far outside a click's window (240 Hz frames, each side) still counts as hitting it. 1-2 is a gentle assist. At low FPS without CBF, late clicks get up to one rendered frame more, because GD only sees inputs once per frame.

mod-ldm-swap.name: LDM instaswap
mod-ldm-swap.description: Bind a level to its LDM / ULDM version (pause menu > LDM), then press the key to swap between them instantly. The LDM version's own start positions are removed and replaced with the ones from the level you're on, and you stay on the start position you were on.

ldm-swap-key.name: LDM swap key
ldm-swap-key.description: Swaps between the level and the LDM version bound to it.
